facts: KPI cockpit for Canada: MTD = Oct 2026, YTD = Jan-Oct 2026; Actual vs LY (prior year) and vs Budget; USD at budget rate.
Direct margin: MTD 61.4% (3.0 pp below LY, unfavourable; 2.9 pp below Budget, unfavourable); YTD 61.5% (1.3 pp below LY, unfavourable; 2.5 pp below Budget, unfavourable).
Production: MTD USD 17.6M (8.7% below LY, unfavourable; 13.2% below Budget, unfavourable); YTD USD 177.8M (2.3% below LY, unfavourable; 11.3% below Budget, unfavourable).
Direct staff costs: MTD USD 6.8M (0.9% lower than LY, favourable; 6.1% lower than Budget, favourable); YTD USD 68.4M (1.2% higher than LY, unfavourable; 5.2% lower than Budget, favourable).

Utilization rate (billable / available hours): MTD 73.7% (4.5 pp below LY, unfavourable; 2.5 pp below Budget, unfavourable); YTD 73.3% (2.7 pp below LY, unfavourable; 2.9 pp below Budget, unfavourable).
Production per billable hour: MTD USD 190.9 (0.3% above LY, favourable; 4.5% below Budget, unfavourable); YTD USD 198.1 (2.8% above LY, favourable; 3.3% below Budget, unfavourable).
Production per FTE (annualised): MTD USD 199k (5.2% below LY, unfavourable; 7.6% below Budget, unfavourable); YTD USD 198k (0.7% below LY, unfavourable; 7.0% below Budget, unfavourable).
Overtime ratio (overtime / available hours): MTD 7.0% (1.3 pp below LY, favourable; 0.9 pp below Budget, favourable); YTD 6.0% (0.6 pp below LY, favourable; 0.7 pp below Budget, favourable).

Production hourly cost (direct staff cost per billable hour): MTD USD 73.7 (8.8% higher than LY, unfavourable; 3.3% higher than Budget, unfavourable); YTD USD 76.2 (6.5% higher than LY, unfavourable; 3.4% higher than Budget, unfavourable).
Direct staff costs / Production: MTD 38.6% (3.0 pp above LY, unfavourable; 2.9 pp above Budget, unfavourable); YTD 38.5% (1.3 pp above LY, unfavourable; 2.5 pp above Budget, unfavourable).
Gross margin: MTD 22.8% (4.7 pp below LY, unfavourable; 5.0 pp below Budget, unfavourable); YTD 23.1% (2.2 pp below LY, unfavourable; 4.3 pp below Budget, unfavourable).
Operating margin on revenue: MTD 11.6% (6.2 pp below LY, unfavourable; 6.5 pp below Budget, unfavourable); YTD 12.1% (3.0 pp below LY, unfavourable; 5.5 pp below Budget, unfavourable).
